name: Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd is in the business of constructions of residential, commercial complexes and IT parks[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AFHL is in the business of handling real estate projects in Chennai. It undertakes commercial and residential projects where ~95% of all developments executed are Joint Developments

Debtor days have improved from 150 to 68.5 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.61 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 11.1% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.58%
